mechanism.component_clock: Each strategy accumulates its own fractional upper-tier credit, preventing physical evaluation order from assigning all larger positions to one strategy.
mechanism.downcross_reset: Fractional credit can be cleared when the portfolio falls below the high-tier boundary so stale exposure debt does not survive a failed crossing.
mechanism.entry_constraint: Every observed opportunity remains an entry; only its adjacent integer volume tier changes.
mechanism.target: Only 2x-to-3x and higher transitions are softened; the economically productive 1x-to-2x transition remains unchanged.

question: Can adjacent integer volume tiers be mixed causally across opportunities to smooth high-tier exposure without dropping entries?

search.limit: This first-order proxy rescales observed stressed outcomes. Because volume changes stop geometry and later balances, real-tick runtime mutation remains decisive.
